scope: Non-pooled realization ledger for national modeled load, Prince William fiscal/physical reporting, and Virginia large-load governance and stress records.

events.object: Historical US data-center electricity use estimate
events.source_locator: LBNL United States Data Center Energy Usage Report: 2025 Update, historical estimate
events.boundary: A national estimate cannot be assigned to a county, customer, feeder, household bill, or realized AI capability.

events.source_locator: LBNL United States Data Center Energy Usage Report: 2025 Update, 2030 reference and sensitivity cases
events.boundary: A scenario is not observed demand, an approved interconnection, a residential surcharge, or proof of strategic capability.

events.recipient: County fiscal system and data-center industry aggregate
events.object: Reported data-center fiscal inflow and local physical-capacity additions
events.source_locator: Prince William County TY2025 Data Center Revenue Report
events.boundary: Reported revenue and capacity do not establish net public benefit, service costs, household incidence, water burden, ownership, or realized compute capability.

events.actor: Virginia State Corporation Commission and state utility governance system
events.recipient: Covered large-load customers, utilities, and residential rate classes
events.object: Large-load cost-allocation, minimum-charge, obligation, disclosure, and implementation response
events.source_locator: Virginia large-load governance and reliability record
events.boundary: Policy terms and filings do not establish realized bills, defaults, enforcement, household fairness, or durable bargaining power.

events.recipient: Virginia electric grid and large-load customers
events.object: Two separately reported large-load drop events
events.source_locator: Virginia SCC SB1239 report summary of Dominion testimony
events.boundary: The events do not identify facility exposure, duration-by-site, household service loss, independent causality, or long-run resilience.

events.object: Customer response modes during the reported large-load drop events

observed_response_modes: ride-through using UPS or controller feedback
full trip offline after reclosing cycles

events.source_locator: Virginia SCC SB1239 report, Dominion large-load event discussion, p. 8
events.boundary: The report does not identify which named facility used which response, event duration by site, household effect, customer cost, or the causal role of equipment or contract terms.

events.actor: Dominion Energy Virginia and supporting parties in SCC Case PUR-2025-00058
events.recipient: High-load customers and other Virginia rate classes
events.object: Proposed high-load customer terms and account-aggregation rules
events.source_locator: Virginia SCC Joint High Load Proposal and Recommended Stipulation, Case PUR-2025-00058
events.boundary: A filing/recommended stipulation is not proof of final adoption, customer acceptance, facility-level load, event participation, billed cost, cost recovery, or household incidence.

events.recipient: Prince William County Innovation Park and southern Data Center Opportunity Zone Overlay District
events.object: Proposed double-circuit 230 kV transmission line and switching station
events.source_locator: Dominion Energy Hornbaker-Devlin project page; proposal submitted to Virginia SCC in March 2025
events.boundary: The proposal does not establish construction, energization, facility-specific load, customer causation, cost recovery, reliability improvement, or household benefit.

events.recipient: Large-load customers, utilities, and residential rate classes
events.object: Direct-assignment framework and amended transmission cost-allocation method for large-load growth
events.source_locator: Virginia SCC facts page, posted September 3, 2026, direct-assignment and Rider T1 sections
events.boundary: The values are a modeled incidence illustration, not an observed bill or payment; implementation, account-level allocation, enforcement, and public response remain open.

events.actor: Virginia SCC docket participant / rate-allocation record
events.recipient: Residential ratepayers and large-load data-center customers
events.object: Public attribution of socialized transmission-cost recovery through Rider T1
events.source_locator: Virginia SCC docket document 241240049, p. 16, Q18/A18
events.boundary: Docket testimony is not a causal household-burden estimate; it does not identify the facility, counterfactual bill, data-center share, payment hardship, or later household behavior.

events.object: Same-place join from data-center capacity and governance to actual household bills, service outcomes, water/land burden, ownership, or realized AI capability
events.boundary: This bounded non-observation is not proof that the effects do not exist; it records that the current sources do not support the join.

boundary: National modeled demand, county aggregate reporting, policy terms, and utility events remain separate units. This ledger is not a household burden estimate, reliability causal estimate, or geopolitical-leverage measure.
